```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("Project0_Clean_v2.csv") %>%
  transmute(
    id = SubjectID,
    day = DAYNUMB, # day number: should be 1 - 3
    sample = Collection.Sample, # sample number of a day: 1 - 4
    sleep = Sleep.Diary.reported.wake.time, 
    # time
    booklet = if_else(sample == 1, 0,
      Booklet..Sample.interval.Decimal.Time..mins.),
    cap = if_else(sample == 1, 0,
      MEMs..Sample.interval.Decimal.Time..mins.),
    # outcome
    cortisol = Cortisol..nmol.L.,
    dhea = DHEA..nmol.L.)
```

# check that everyone has 12 records
```{r}
data %>%
  count(id) %>% count(n)
# Yes
```
# check if the first sample always has wake-up time
```{r}
table(
  sample1 = data$sample == 1,
  wake_na = data$sleep != "")
# Yes, sample = 1 means having wake-up time
```
# check missing rows
```{r}
data %>%
  summarise(
    booklet_missing = sum(is.na(booklet)),
    cap_missing = sum(is.na(cap)),
    cortisol_missing = sum(is.na(cortisol)),
    dhea_missing = sum(is.na(dhea)))
```
# check booklet missing included in cap missing
```{r}
table(
  booklet_na = is.na(data$booklet),
  cap_na = is.na(data$cap))
# No, there are only 17 rows overlapping
# we only have 268/372 rows in terms of non-missing time
```

# check range of time and outcomes
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = booklet)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of booklet")

ggplot(data, aes(x = cap)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of cap")

ggplot(data, aes(x = cortisol)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of cortisol")

ggplot(data, aes(x = dhea)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of dhea")
```

```{r}
data %>%
  summarise(
    booklet_min = min(booklet, na.rm = TRUE),
    booklet_max = max(booklet, na.rm = TRUE),
    cap_min = min(cap, na.rm = TRUE),
    cap_max = max(cap, na.rm = TRUE),
    cortisol_min = min(cortisol, na.rm = TRUE),
    cortisol_max = max(cortisol, na.rm = TRUE),
    dhea_min = min(dhea, na.rm = TRUE),
    dhea_max = max(dhea, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r}
# following advice from PI, set threshold for two outcomes and remove outliers
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    dhea_cleaned = if_else(dhea > 0.205, NA_real_, dhea),
    cortisol_cleaned = if_else(cortisol > 80, NA_real_, cortisol))
```
